description: Migration, Cloning, and BCDR, powered by KubeDB Courier, extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.
section_title: Move, Branch, and Protect Your Databases
section_subtitle: Migration, Cloning, and BCDR, powered by KubeDB Courier, extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.

capabilities.title: BCDR: Near-Zero Downtime
capabilities.description: Keep applications running when an entire data center goes down, with automatic or approved failover and zero data loss for your most critical workloads.
benefits: Automatic failover, or manual control when you prefer
Planned switchovers for maintenance and drills, no data lost
Only one site in charge, even when the network splits
Backup and point-in-time recovery built in, for added safety

capabilities.title: Zero-Downtime Migration
capabilities.description: Move to KubeDB from another cloud or on-premises while your applications keep running. Your current system serves traffic until you decide to switch.
benefits: Powered by KubeDB Courier, enabled with one Helm flag
No maintenance window: your users stay online throughout
Continuous sync keeps both sides in step until cutover
Cut over in minutes, with every step versioned and tracked

capabilities.title: Cloning and Branching
capabilities.description: Give developers and test pipelines realistic production data without putting production at risk. Isolated, refreshable branches are coming next.
benefits: Built on KubeDB Courier, the engine behind migration
Realistic data for development, testing, and upgrades
Production stays untouched, protected, and fully isolated
Same simple, declarative experience as all of KubeDB
